Crehan’s Kitchen

I was looking through the “latest comments” for the tunes section here and Dow’s comments and versions for this tune were on the page. I’ve been looking for this tune for a long time. No, not to learn it, I already knew it. But having heard “Crehan’s Kitchen” played by Catherine McEvoy on “The Flute Players of Roscommon” I knew there was another title on it, and this is it.

↳ Posted by Paahto on May 16th, 2008.

Miss Ramsey, X:6

This appears in the Athole Collection as a Strathspey. Here is the setting from the Athole Collection. Also, the tune was originally written in E Flat Major.

Miss Ramsay, X:7

Based on the great version by the late Tommy Peoples and Seán Óg Potts on Waiting For a Call https://thesession.org/recordings/460 . It features a satisfying number of those characteristic arpeggios on A and D.
